Frontend Engineer

Rotterdam, Netherlands · Full-time · Hybrid

Share on LinkedIn Share by email

About the role

Harbor Mills makes billing software for small shops. As a frontend engineer you will own our customer pages, from the first sketch to the release, together with design and product.

You will join a team of six engineers who ship every day and care about accessible, fast interfaces.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of React and TypeScript
  • Experience with design systems and accessibility (WCAG 2.2)
  • Comfortable writing tests: Vitest, Playwright

What we offer

  1. A yearly learning budget
  2. Four days in the office, one at home
